outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of gadolinium-enhanced MRI for cesarean scar pregnancy
Diagnostic accuracy of ultrasound for cesarean scar pregnancy
cohort: 42 consecutive patients with suspected cesarean scar pregnancy.
finding: Gadolinium-enhanced MRI demonstrated high specificity (97.6%) in diagnosing cesarean scar pregnancy, while initial ultrasound had lower specificity (81%) but improved with repeat examinations.
